definitions.explanation: To officially announce or disclose information to the public. Implies a deliberate act of releasing information that was previously private or restricted.

examples.japanese: {調査|ちょうさ}{結果|けっか}を{公表|こうひょう}する。
{政府|せいふ}は{新|あら}たな{対策|たいさく}を{公表|こうひょう}した。
{個人|こじん}{情報|じょうほう}の{保護|ほご}のため、{氏名|しめい}は{公表|こうひょう}されなかった。
examples.english: The names were not disclosed in order to protect personal information.

notes:
A formal word used for official disclosures. Common in news reporting and government communications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{結果|けっか}を{公表|こうひょう}する (announce results)
・データを{公表|こうひょう}する (release data)
・{氏名|しめい}を{公表|こうひょう}する (disclose names)
・{公表|こうひょう}を{控|ひか}える (refrain from disclosure)

COMPARISON:
・{発表|はっぴょう}: a broader term for announcements, presentations, and releases
・{公表|こうひょう}: specifically making something public that was previously private
・{公開|こうかい}: opening something to the public (documents, facilities, events)
